excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的表面散步着金属碎片。这些碎片大多看起来属于许多不同的飞船。
excerpt.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

sections.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

texts.zh: 在遥远的过去，这颗小行星显然被某些人在某段时间当成了垃圾场。各种各样的报废器械和金属废料都被小行星的低重力捕获，被缓缓地拉到一大堆残骸碎石之中，现在这些残骸碎石已经覆盖了小行星的表面。在这里我们没有发现什么有价值的东西，但许多金属可以用开采站回收。
texts.en: This asteroid was evidently used as a junkyard by someone at some point in the distant past. All manner of discarded machinery and metallic refuse has been deposited inside the asteroid's weak gravity well, being slowly pulled into the jumble of debris that now covers the surface. There is nothing of particular value to be found here, but a lot of the metal could be salvaged by a mining station.

label.zh: 回收一切可以回收的东西。
label.en: We should recycle what we can.

texts.zh: 我们的传感器发现了[From.GetName]上的舰船残骸是通过某种罕见的方式抵达那里的。这些舰船似乎是从大约数光年以外故意地径直开向小行星，用以测试设计者推进器的精确度。在对残骸进行深度扫描时，我们找到了那么一艘推进装置相当完好无损的舰船。
texts.en: Our sensors have discovered that the ship remnants on [From.GetName] got there in a peculiar way. The ships seem to have been intentionally driven straight into the asteroid, probably from light-years away, to test the accuracy of the designers' thrusters. As we deep-scan the remains, we pick out one ship in particular, which seems to have reasonably intact propulsion.

label.zh: 我们不会浪费那些合金的。

summary.text:
# 覆盖着残骸 / Covered in Debris

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:69; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:216 (anomaly.30); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:2377 (anomaly.6800)

## 如何开始 How it starts

没有战略资源的小行星可能生成（3级，权重3）。

Can spawn on an asteroid without a strategic resource (level 3, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.30“垃圾场”（清除矿藏后加 d_minerals_3 + junkyard 修正，并可触发 pop_lcluster_event）与 anomaly.6800“打靶训练”（选项a：获得或推进 tech_afterburners_1/2；选项b：d_alloys_3 合金矿藏 + ship_graveyard 修正）。

anomaly.30 "Junkyard" (deposits cleared, adds d_minerals_3 plus the junkyard modifier, and may trigger pop_lcluster_event) and anomaly.6800 "Target Practice" (a: tech_afterburners_1 or progress toward tech_afterburners_2; b: d_alloys_3 deposit plus ship_graveyard modifier).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个结果互斥，各50%。

The results are exclusive, 50% each.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异。

No empire differences.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对；编译树正确。pop_lcluster_event 属 L 星团线索的共享效果，不属于本故事。

Checked; the compiled tree is correct. pop_lcluster_event is the shared L-Cluster clue effect, not part of this story.
